newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran to recall EU envoys in diplomatic row-IRNA.
newsitem.headline: Iran to recall EU envoys in diplomatic row-IRNA.

text.p: Iran will recall its ambassadors from European Union states who have summoned their Tehran envoys after a German court's verdict that the Islamic republic ordered political killings in Germany, Iran's official news agency IRNA said.
IRNA late on Saturday quoted a Foreign Ministry source as saying Iran would "reciprocate the decision of the (EU) governments to recall their ambassadors from Tehran".

EU members, with the exception of Greece, recalled their envoys for consultations following Thursday's Berlin court ruling that Iranian leaders ordered the 1992 killings of four Kurdish dissidents in Germany.
Iran, which has repeatedly denied all involvement in the killings, has urged EU states not to jeopardise their interests in Iran over the verdict.
